description: Credential-free desired tool inventory for SketchScape planning and development automation.
format_status: Documentation only. This is not claimed to be a native NemoClaw, OpenShell, MCP, or agent import format.
credentials: Resolve authentication through the approved runtime credential provider; never store credentials in this file.

http_operations.purpose: Start approved GPU inference capacity before bounded reconstruction work.

Submit one or more views and prompts to SAM 3.1 followed by Fast-SAM3D to create a catalog asset. subject_hint is optional: when empty and no mask is uploaded, NemoClaw identify_subject labels the object (Build Plan step 4a; SKETCHSCAPE_SUBJECT_LABELER=mock until the runtime exists).
http_operations.approval_reason: May start or consume metered GPU capacity outside mock mode.

http_operations.purpose: List reconstructed and curated assets available to blueprints.
Create a revisioned draft conforming to shared/experience-blueprint.schema.json.
Validate schema, project asset references, readiness, and allowlisted interactions.
Promote a validated blueprint revision as the project's published source of truth.
Export a published compiled scene and same-origin PLY artifacts into the Unity authoring folder.
Fetch the runtime scene compiled from the project's published blueprint.

Collaborative VR: read the live revision, objects, and ownership of a room (callable name get_room_state). Authenticated with NemoClaw's shared service token (SKETCHSCAPE_NEMOCLAW_TOKEN, built -- see docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md R14). Build Plan step 21 (backend route: done); step 24 (backend/room_tools.py, backend/room_tools_cli.py) built ahead of the step 3 gate, at the user's explicit request, untested (2026-09-26).

Collaborative VR: draft a room edit as a new revision based on the live revision (callable name propose_room_edit). Never publishes; publishing uses blueprint.publish with approval. Returns 409 if the room changed. A person approves the publish on the website. Build Plan step 24; the underlying draft route (blueprint.draft, above) is already implemented.

Guided tour bot: save the GuidedTour JSON that author_guided_tour wrote after place_objects_in_scene and stage_immersive_reveal (shared/guided-tour.schema.json). Stored as a draft only; the backend validates every id against the blueprint and every fact against the contributions. Authenticated with SKETCHSCAPE_NEMOCLAW_TOKEN (R14). Build Plan steps 30-31.
http_operations.implementation_status: implemented; nemoclaw-tool-built-untested-step31 (see tour.author_guided_tour below) -- set to implemented (drop the step31 caveat) once verified against a live NemoClaw run per nemoclaw-tour-authoring's definition of done

http_operations.purpose: Guided tour bot: make a draft tour the one the in-room guide performs. People only: a service identity gets 403. A person clicks Activate on the website. Build Plan step 30.
http_operations.approval_reason: Changes what the guide says to everyone in the room.

nemoclaw_agent_tools.path: backend/scene_tools_cli.py place_objects_in_scene (installed in the NemoClaw sandbox as the sketchscape-scene-tools OpenClaw skill, config/nemoclaw/skills/sketchscape-scene-tools/SKILL.md)
nemoclaw_agent_tools.purpose: Build Plan step 4: callable name place_objects_in_scene(objects: list[{asset_id, label}], sketch_layout_hint). Deterministic interior-design layout reasoning (arc placement, depth variation, label-driven relative scale); returns a schema-valid ExperienceBlueprintInput. Never publishes.

Build Plan step 4: callable name read_sketch_layout(sketch_image). Optional. Mock backend returns no relations (honest, no real vision signal yet); nemoclaw backend raises until NemoClaw's vision model path (Build Plan step 3) is wired up.

Build Plan step 6: callable name stage_immersive_reveal(connection_insight, objects). Reveal order, theme-keyed lighting/mood preset, connecting light-path motif, spoken-narration text, per-object haptic signature. Backend-side tool only (Part A); Unity-side toolkit integration (Part B) waits on Unity Editor being available.

nemoclaw_agent_tools.path: backend/room_tools_cli.py get_room_state (installed in the NemoClaw sandbox as the sketchscape-room-tools OpenClaw skill, config/nemoclaw/skills/sketchscape-room-tools/SKILL.md)
nemoclaw_agent_tools.purpose: Build Plan step 24: callable name get_room_state(project_id). GET /v1/rooms/{project_id}/state with NemoClaw's service token; returns a concise summary (or the full state with response_format=detailed). Read-only.
nemoclaw_agent_tools.implementation_status: built-untested-2026-09-26 (built ahead of the step 3 gate at the user's explicit request; no live NemoClaw runtime to verify tool-calling against yet)

nemoclaw_agent_tools.purpose: Build Plan step 24: callable name propose_room_edit(project_id, base_revision, edits). Fetches the base_revision blueprint, applies the requested transforms, validates, and POSTs a new draft revision via base_revision=<live>. Never publishes. Raises/reports a stale-revision error with fresh room state on 409, per room-api-and-ownership.
nemoclaw_agent_tools.implementation_status: built-untested-2026-09-26 (built ahead of the step 3 gate at the user's explicit request; no live NemoClaw runtime to verify tool-calling against yet)

nemoclaw_agent_tools.path: backend/tour_author.py author_guided_tour(project_id, model_call) -- imported directly by a live NemoClaw session (never shelled out to, unlike the scene/room tools above), since it needs to pass its own model_call for the one live reasoning call this tool makes. backend/tour_author_cli.py exists only for manual/CLI testing with a stub model_call.
nemoclaw_agent_tools.purpose: Build Plan step 31: callable name author_guided_tour(project_id). Reads compiled-scene, the latest ConnectionInsight, contributions, and contributors; writes the GuidedTour JSON in one model call through NemoClaw's configured provider; POSTs it as a draft (tour.draft above), retrying up to 2 times on a validator 422 with the rule message fed back. Never activates -- a person does that on the website.
nemoclaw_agent_tools.implementation_status: built-untested-2026-09-26 (deterministic read/write/retry logic unit-tested in backend/test_tour_author.py with a stub model_call; no live NemoClaw runtime to verify tool-calling or the real model_call against yet, per nemoclaw-tour-authoring's definition of done)

unity_mcp_connection.endpoint: https://<windows-side WSL gateway IP>:9443/mcp/ (trusted-private; never public)
unity_mcp_connection.setup: scripts/unity-mcp-bridge/Setup-UnityMcpBridge.ps1 (see its README). Bridge: tls_proxy.py -> mcp-proxy -> relay_win.exe --mcp -> Unity Editor. The sandbox trusts the per-machine private CA via NEMOCLAW_CORPORATE_CA_BUNDLE at onboard.
unity_mcp_connection.implementation_status: implemented-verified-2026-09-26 (live NemoClaw agent tools/call to meta_get_config_information returned real Editor data)
